test_title: PYST 75: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Arushya purchased __the most good__ of all the suits kept in the shop.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of "**most good**."
 
• The correct superlative form of "good" is "**best**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the best**" to represent the superlative degree correctly.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate substitution is **the best**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Arushya purchased the best of all the suits kept in the shop."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the goods"** – This option is incorrect because "goods" refers to items or products, not the superlative degree of "good".
 
• **Option 3: "the more good"** – This option is grammatically incorrect because "more good" is not a proper comparative or superlative form.
 
• **Option 4: "the good"** – This option lacks the superlative degree needed to convey that Arushya purchased the best suit.
